"""Operational semantics: ordering, detachment, failed loads, normalization, two cases."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import run, hx
import ref

fails = 0
def expect(name, got, want):
    global fails
    if got != want:
        fails += 1
        print('FAIL', name, '\n  got ', json.dumps(got)[:600], '\n  want', json.dumps(want)[:600])
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)

A = 0x20010db8000000010000000000000000
B = 0x20010db8000000020000000000000000

# 1. two independent cases
req = {'cases': [
  {'ops': [['put', hx(A), 64, 1], ['query', [hx(A)]]]},
  {'ops': [['query', [hx(A)]], ['put', hx(A), 65, 2], ['query', [hx(A)]]]}]}
r = run(req)
expect('two cases', [[x['answers'] for x in r['results']]], [[[1]], [[None], [None]]])
expect('two cases loads/snapshots', [(x['loads'], x['snapshots']) for x in r['results']], [([], []), ([], [])])

# 2. last-write-wins and host bit clearing
req = {'cases': [{'ops': [
    ['put', hx(A | 0xffff), 112, 5],
    ['put', hx(A | 0x1234), 112, 6],
    'X' if False else ['query', [hx(A | 0xabcd), hx(A)]],
]}]}
r = run(req)
expect('last write wins + normalize', r['results'][0]['answers'], [6, 6])

# 3. detachment: save, then puts, then load_saved
ops = [['put', hx(A), 64, 1], ['save'],
       ['put', hx(A), 64, 99], ['put', hx(B), 32, 7], ['save'],
       ['query', [hx(A), hx(B)]],
       ['load_saved', 0], ['image_query', [hx(A), hx(B)]],
       ['load_saved', 1], ['image_query', [hx(A), hx(B)]],
       ['load_saved', 0], ['image_query', [hx(A), hx(B)]]]
r = run({'cases': [{'ops': ops}]})['results'][0]
expect('detached answers', r['answers'], [99, 7, 1, None, 99, 7, 1, None])
expect('detached loads', r['loads'], [True, True, True])
expect('snapshot count', len(r['snapshots']), 2)
ok0, _ = ref.validate_image(r['snapshots'][0]); ok1, _ = ref.validate_image(r['snapshots'][1])
expect('snapshots valid', [ok0, ok1], [True, True])
expect('snapshots differ', r['snapshots'][0] != r['snapshots'][1], True)

# 4. failed load preserves the previous image; successful load replaces it
img0 = r['snapshots'][0]
bad = json.loads(json.dumps(img0)); bad['root'] = [bad['root'][0], bad['root'][1] + 1]
ops = [['load', img0], ['image_query', [hx(A)]],
       ['load', bad], ['image_query', [hx(A)]],
       ['load', {'root': None, 'front16': [], 'front64': [], 'cells': [0]*11,
                 'banks': [[] for _ in range(11)], 'bitmaps': [], 'nexthops': []}],
       ['image_query', [hx(A)]]]
rr = run({'cases': [{'ops': ops}]})['results'][0]
expect('failed load keeps image', rr['loads'], [True, False, True])
expect('failed load answers', rr['answers'], [1, 1, None])

# 5. image_query before any load
rr = run({'cases': [{'ops': [['put', hx(A), 64, 3], ['image_query', [hx(A)]], ['save'],
                             ['image_query', [hx(A)]], ['load_saved', 0], ['image_query', [hx(A)]]]})]})['results'][0]
expect('no image loaded yet', rr['answers'], [None, None, 3])
expect('loads', rr['loads'], [True])

# 6. loading an image built elsewhere (our snapshot) into a fresh case, then query
ops = [['put', hx(B), 128, 42], ['save'], ['load', img0], ['image_query', [hx(A), hx(B)]],
       ['query', [hx(A), hx(B)]]]
rr = run({'cases': [{'ops': ops}]})['results'][0]
expect('load does not touch live fib', rr['answers'], [None, None, None, 42])
expect('load ok', rr['loads'], [True])

# 7. many loads of the same image + saves interleaved (bounds: 16 loads, 3 saves)
ops = []
for i in range(3):
    ops.append(['put', hx(A | (i << 64)), 96, 10 + i]); ops.append(['save'])
for i in range(16):
    ops.append(['load_saved', i % 3])
ops.append(['image_query', [hx(A | (i << 64)) for i in range(3)]])
rr = run({'cases': [{'ops': ops}]})['results'][0]
expect('16 loads all true', rr['loads'], [True]*16)
expect('final image is save #2', rr['answers'], [10, 11, 12])
print('FAILS', fails)
